subject.description: Synthetic tunnel lining segment used only to exercise the assurance-case structure.

decision_context.purpose: Demonstrate the representation of dimensional and provenance obligations; not a real release decision.
decision_context.scope_statement: One synthetic lining segment, one declared design revision, one dimensional inspection profile, and only the evidence explicitly represented in this case.

claims.proposition: The synthetic lining segment satisfies the declared dimensional acceptance rule for the specified design revision.
claims.scope_statement: Only the synthetic segment and declared dimensional inspection profile are in scope.
limitations: No source graph or real measurement bytes are attached.
This proposed claim has not been appraised by an independent verifier.

claims.proposition: The expanded uncertainty interval of the measurement lies wholly within the declared permitted tolerance interval.
claims.scope_statement: Scalar interval rule only; geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, surface, weld, NDT and structural acceptance require separate profiles.
limitations: No numeric measurement, uncertainty budget or tolerance bounds are provided in this fixture.

claims.proposition: The measurement record can be bound to an owner-native source identity, revision and exact payload digest.
claims.scope_statement: Owner namespace, record identifier, revision and payload digest must be present and independently authenticated.
limitations: The current synthetic evidence binding is unresolved and has no source node or payload digest.

arguments.strategy: Conjunctive decomposition: dimensional conformance requires both a valid metrology result and traceable source identity.
arguments.warrant: A measurement result can support acceptance only when the applicable measurement process and uncertainty are valid for the declared tolerance, and the exact source record and revision are identified.

limitations: No owner-native namespace, source bytes, source snapshot or source attestation has been supplied.

assumptions.statement: The declared measurement method is applicable to the component geometry and specified tolerance.
assumptions.impact_if_false: The measurement result may not support the dimensional conformance claim; remeasurement or a different inspection method may be required.

defeaters.condition: The instrument calibration was expired, revoked, or outside its valid scope at the time of measurement.
defeaters.detection_method: Check the instrument calibration record, calibration scope, valid-time interval, revocation history and measurement timestamp.

limitations: This is a synthetic schema fixture, not a real engineering assurance case.
Schema validity does not establish claim truth, argument soundness, evidence authenticity, profile adequacy or engineering safety.
No verifier attestation or relying-party appraisal is present.
The schema does not perform cross-reference resolution, graph-cycle checks, cryptographic signature validation or temporal appraisal.
